english.note: Use 正派 for a person whose character and conduct are morally decent and trustworthy.

exampleSentences.english: They are upright people, so you can trust them.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋個人好正派，做事好有交帶。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 go3 jan4 hou2 zing3 paai1 zou6 si6 hou2 jau5 gaau1 daai3

english.note: Use this for a person who is morally upright, respectable, and decent.

exampleSentences.english: They are a decent person and would not cheat people.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢個人好正派，唔會呃人。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 zing3 paai1 m4 wui5 aak1 jan4
